developer_request: Understand this website repository and continue fixing the current product alignment issues.
known_facts: HANDOFF.md says the repository is a deployable product-language/prototype surface whose current capabilities must be mapped and integrated rather than broadly rewritten.
The repository centralizes three-site URLs in data/site.ts.
At capture time, data/site.ts still defaults the Foundation link to the historical YuemingHub/Ming-Foundation repository identity.
The current accepted Foundation repository identity used by the current MingOS coordination model is YuemingHub/mingos-foundation.
expected_first_moves: Read the handoff and current site configuration rather than inventorying every page/component.
Reconcile the Foundation repository identity against the current authoritative coordination/source record.
Classify the stale local default URL as a current local execution delta in ymai-website.
Reroute to the appropriate implementation route or fix the bounded local reference under current authorization, then verify the configured link/related tests or build evidence.
must_preserve: The handoff rule that current prototype surfaces should be integrated/calibrated rather than needlessly rewritten.
The historical repository identity as provenance where appropriate, while the user-facing/default current link uses the accepted current repository.
must_not: Stop after writing an analysis that merely notes the stale Foundation link when the user already authorized continued product-alignment work.
Return verified-no-op when current local evidence proves a stale reference remains.
Expand the fix into an unrelated website redesign, cross-repository mutation, or provider installation.
lessons: The execution-delta gate must prevent invented work without becoming an excuse for analysis paralysis.
When recovery finds a concrete current local delta inside the requested action class, AAOP should transition into the smallest executable change and verify it.
